construction.note: This uses Manuel Martínez Vela’s published grid method and drawing 1 on the eight-pointed-star grid in ALZADA 115, page 45. We read the outlines and supplied the compass construction and step grouping.
construction.changes: The article explains the shared grid and shows the completed tracing. It does not give this pattern’s numbered app sequence. Its separate nine-step Partal example is a different pattern. Source credits identify the design and method, not a verbatim sequence.

credits.source: La Alhambra con regla y compás: el trazado de los diseños geométricos nazaríes (ALZADA 115, 2017)
credits.creator: Manuel Martínez Vela
credits.note: The grid of eight-pointed stars (each turned square found with a circle through the diagonal grid corners) and the tracing of this Comares panel (the article's drawing 1) follow this article.

given.O: The centre of one eight-pointed star.
given.A: Any point to the right of O. The distance OA is one square of the grid.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A. Keep this compass size while you build the grid. The distance OA is one square of the grid.

Draw a vertical line through O. It crosses the first circle at E and G. The horizontal line crosses it at A and C. Draw circles with centres A and C, through O. They cross the horizontal line again at B and D. Draw circles with centres E and G, through O. They cross the vertical line again at F and H.
Draw a vertical line through each of D, C, A and B. Draw a horizontal line through each of H, G, E and F. The lines make a square grid.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a vertical line through C. Draw a vertical line through A. Draw a horizontal line through G. Draw a horizontal line through E. The four lines make the square around O.

steps.text: Draw a circle with centre O through K1, the corner of the grid square at the top right. It crosses the horizontal line at S1 and S3. Draw the line through O that halves the angle AOE. Draw the line through O that halves the angle EOC. Draw two lines through S1, parallel to these two lines. Draw two lines through S3, parallel to these two lines. They make an eight-pointed star.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a circle with centre O through K1, the corner of the square at the top right. It crosses the horizontal line at S1 and S3. Draw two lines at 45° through S1, one sloping up and one sloping down. Draw the same two lines through S3. They make an eight-pointed star.

steps.text: Join B, F, D and H to mark the tile that repeats. It stands on a corner, two squares from O each way. The points where the star turns come by themselves.

ink.text: Ink the star: from S1 through N1, K1, N2, S2 and on round the star, back to S1. Its points are S1 to S4 and K1 to K4, and its notches N1 to N8.

pattern.text: Put copies of the tile side by side. Notched eight-pointed stars and crosses take turns, as in a tile panel of the Hall of Comares.

expect.note: Golden values in grid squares (OA = one square), computed by the engine; the pieces fill the tile.
